$comment: P112 §12 cross-runtime reference parity fixture. Each case calls a static Probe function of `source` on a fresh session; `returns` pins its result and `refuses` a fragment of the error it throws. The web half runs the cases through `neo test`; the Unity half runs them over a `neo export` of the same source. Vendor this file verbatim.
source: public Box(T v) { this.Value = v; this.R = Reference(this.Value); }
public void Hear(int v) { this.Heard = v; }

public Gauge() { this.A = Reference(this.Count); this.RR = Reference(this.A); this.At = Reference(this.Spot); this.FeelRef = Reference(this.Feel); this.XsRef = this.Xs; this.Chosen = this.Picks; this.Pinned = Reference(this.Count); }
@storage(allowed: .Session) public static Gauge G = new() { Xs = [1, 5] };
public static void Listen() { Probe.G.A.OnChanged += Probe.G.Hear; }
public static void RebindToOther() { Probe.G.A = Reference(Probe.G.Other); }
public static int Heard() { return Probe.G.Heard; }
public static int ReadThrough() { var g = Probe.G; g.A = Reference(g.Count); g.RR = Reference(g.A); return g.A + g.RR; }
public static int ReadWrite() { var g = Probe.G; g.A = Reference(g.Count); g.A = 7; g.A = Reference(g.Other); g.A += 2; return g.Count * 100 + g.Other; }
public static int Layers() { var g = Probe.G; g.A = Reference(g.Count); g.RR = Reference(g.A); g.RR = 9; g.RR = Reference(g.Other); g.RR = 4; return g.Count * 100 + g.Other; }
public static bool VectorThrough() { var g = Probe.G; g.At = Reference(g.Spot); g.At = new Vector2(3, 4); return g.Spot == new Vector2(3, 4); }
public static bool EnumThrough() { var g = Probe.G; g.FeelRef = Reference(g.Feel); g.FeelRef = Mood.Happy; return g.Feel == Mood.Happy; }

public static int StaticSlot() { var g = Probe.G; g.A = Reference(Probe.Total); g.A += 5; Probe.Pin = Reference(g.Other); var pin = Probe.Pin; if (pin != null) { pin = 1; } return Probe.Total * 100 + g.Other; }
public static int PicksByTarget() { var g = Probe.G; g.Other = 3; g.Picks.Add(Reference(g.Count)); g.Picks.Add(Reference(g.Count)); g.Picks.Add(Reference(g.Other)); return g.Picks.Count; }

public static int ChosenSet() { var g = Probe.G; g.Picks.Add(Reference(g.Count)); g.Chosen = g.Picks; g.Picks.Add(Reference(g.Other)); int sum = 0; foreach (var r in g.Chosen) { sum += r; } return g.Chosen.Count * 100 + sum; }
public static int Equal() { var g = Probe.G; g.Other = 3; g.A = Reference(g.Count); return g.A == Reference(g.Other) ? 1 : 0; }
public static int KeepsStaticListRow() { var g = Probe.G; g.XsRef = Probe.Shared; Probe.Shared = g.Ys; g.Ys.Add(9); return g.XsRef.Count * 10 + Probe.Shared[1]; }
public static int KeepsListRow() { var g = Probe.G; g.XsRef = g.Xs; g.Xs = g.Ys; g.Ys.Add(9); return g.XsRef.Count * 10 + g.Xs[1]; }
public static int ReadonlyTarget() { var g = Probe.G; g.A = Reference(g.Fixed); g.A = 1; return 0; }
public static int ConstructedPin() { var g = new Gauge(); g.Count = 6; return g.Pinned; }
public static int SavedPinsSession() { var t = new Tally(); Probe.SavedPin = Reference(t.N); return 0; }
public static int SavedPinsSessionClosure() { var t = new Tally(); Reference<int> r = Reference(t.N); Probe.Hook = () => r; return 0; }
public static int SavedPinsSessionDictionary() { var t = new Tally(); Dictionary<string, Reference<int>> rs = { "n": Reference(t.N) }; Probe.Hook = () => rs["n"]; return 0; }
public static int SavedOwnerSessionSlot() { var t = new Tally(); Probe.Board.Note = Reference(t.N); var note = Probe.Board.Note; return note ?? 0; }
public static int StoreHook() { Reference<int> r = Reference(Probe.Saved); List<Reference<int>> rs = [r]; Probe.Hook = () => r + rs[0]; return 0; }
public static int CallHook() { Probe.Saved = 5; var hook = Probe.Hook; return hook != null ? hook() : 0; }
public static int SavedHookReads() { Probe.StoreHook(); return Probe.CallHook(); }
public static int SavedPinsStatic() { Probe.Loose = 3; Probe.SavedMaybe = Reference(Probe.Loose); return 0; }
public static int SavedPinsAuthored() { Probe.SavedPin = Reference(Probe.Total); var pin = Probe.SavedPin; return pin ?? 0; }
public static int SavedPinsSaved() { Probe.SavedPin = Reference(Probe.Saved); var pin = Probe.SavedPin; if (pin != null) { pin = 4; } return Probe.Saved; }
public static int Entry() { var g = Probe.G; if (g.Pick != null) { g.Pick += 4; } return g.Xs[0] * 10 + g.Xs.Count; }
public static int EntryRemoved() { var g = Probe.G; g.Xs.RemoveAt(0); return g.Pick ?? 0; }
public static int HeldWrite() { var g = Probe.G; if (g.Held != null) { g.Held = 2; } return 0; }
public static int ReadA() { return Probe.G.A; }
public static int GenericSlot() { var b = new Box<int>(v: 2); b.R = 5; return b.Value; }
public static bool GenericHandle() { var t = new Tally(); var b = new Box<Tally>(v: new Tally()); b.R = t; return b.R == t && b.Value != t; }
